title: A niche starts a Space's tools from an existing preset, and the owner can see it
detail: NICHE_DEFAULTS maps each niche to an existing capability bundle. Creation starts the tools from the niche when no explicit preset or Focus did, and Menu and features gets a Starting setup card that saves the niche and applies the preset only to a Space whose switches were never touched. No new writer, no grant.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; vitest on niche-defaults, niche-start and provision-core passes.
